List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

————
(Ministries : Coal; Defence; Home Affairs; Mines; Non-Conventional Energy
Sources; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions;

WIN2/NSESSION\3901RS 68
Rape of Swiss diplomat
*221. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of  HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any breakthrough in the case
of rape of a Swiss Diplomat having been
abducted in her own car from the Siri Fort
Auditorium Parking on 14th October, 2003
has been achieved;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, what steps are being taken to
nab the culprits;
(d) what was the deployment of police
personnel at the parking outside Siri Fort
Auditorium on that day; and
(e) if no policeman was posted there,
the action taken against the concerned
officers responsible for the lapse?
Subsidy on modern looms
†*222. SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH: Will the Minister of TEXTILES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to increase subsidy on modern looms; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
proposed amount of subsidy?
BPL families identified under
SJGSY
*223. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of  RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of BPL families identified
under the Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar
Yojana, State-wise;
(b) the names of States which did not
contribute their share of funds alongwith
the reasons therefor;
(c) whether there were large scale
diversions and misutilisation of the funds and
if so, the number of complaints received in
this regard, State-wise; and
(d) the steps taken to check the
deficiencies?
State Disaster Management
Authorities
*224. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of  HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry of Home
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

69
WIN2/NSESSION\3901RS 69
Affairs has asked the States to set up State
Disaster Management Authorities which
would act as nodal agency in dealing with
emergency situation; and
(b) if so, the number of States which have
taken action in this regard?
Army colleges and institutions in the
country
*225. SHRI BACHANI LEKHRAJ:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of army colleges and
institutions in the country;
(b) the places where they are located;
(c) whether any college/institute is also
located in Gujarat;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Financial help to J&K for
handicrafts exports
*226. MISS MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
 Will the Minister of  TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Jammu and Kashmir
propose to boost handicrafts exports;
(b) whether Government have extended
financial help to the State for infrastructural
development in the sector;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government have any
similar proposal under consideration to help
other backward States such as Orissa, Bihar
and  Madhya Pradesh, etc.; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Atrocities on dalits in
Tamil Nadu
*227. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the increasing incidents of
atrocities on dalits in the Southern districts
of Tamil Nadu, particularly Madurai; and
(b) if so, the number of such cases
reported during the last three years?
Expansion of NALCO
*228. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of  MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Aluminium
Company Ltd. (NALCO) is heading for
expansion;
(b) if so, the details of the expansion
proposed by NALCO;
(c) the amount of investment involved in
the expansion programme; and
(d) the time limit fixed for the same?
Hydel Power Development
Policy, 1998
†*229. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI  RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had formulated the Hydel Power
Development Policy in 1998;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that the
construction of Small Hydel Projects were
targeted to be boosted up under the policy;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

70
WIN2/NSESSION\3901RS 70
(d) whether Government have made any
assessment in respect of power generation
capacity in the Small Hydro Power Sector;
(e) if so, the quantum thereof; and
(f) the number of projects that came into
existence since the formulation of the policy
alongwith the existing power generation
thereof?
Amendments in Sections 406 and
498A of IPC
*230. SHRI  ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of  HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many families
in India are suffering due to exaggerated
allegations of harassment and dowry cases
made by women against their husbands and
other family members involving them in
criminal misappropriation and cruelty;
(b) if so, the steps Government propose
to take in this regard;
(c) whether the Hon'ble High Court in a
judgement on 19th May, 2003 has directed
the Government to review and make suitable
amendments in Sections 406 and 498 A of
IPC; and
(d) if so, the action Government have
taken or propose to take on the judgement
of the Court?
National level committees for growth
and expansion of textiles units
†*231. SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
 Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
constituted any committees at national level
during the last three years for seeking
suggestion for growth and expansion of units
in various sectors of textile production in the
country;
(b) if so, the sector-wise (mill, powerloom
and handloom) details of such committees
and when each of the committees was
constituted; and
(c) the details of reports submitted by
these committees?
Investment in coal sector
*232. SHRI ABHAY KANT PRASAD:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) the amount earmarked for the coal
sector during the current year alongwith the
investment made so far in this sector;
(b) the amount made available as
investment in this sector by the Union
Government and by way of foreign
assistance separately; and
(c) the target fixed in regard to coal
production during the current year and the
extent to which the targets have been met
so far?
Allotment of land to people below
poverty line
*233. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to allot
land to landless people in rural areas who
fall below poverty line, on priority basis;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have made any
study of shelterless households in the
country;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

71
WIN2/NSESSION\3901RS 71
(d) if so, the State-wise details thereof;
and
(e) by when these shelterless people will
be provided land?
Disinvestment in NTC mills
*234. SHRI S. AGNIRAJ: Will the
Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of NTC mills identified
for disinvestment/sell off;
(b) the reasons for delay in disinvestment/
sell off of such mills;
(c) whether Government are planning
any VRS for the affected workers; and
(d) what will be the total pay off for this
VRS?
Recruitments by IAF
*235. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that IAF has
decided to go to professional institutions like
IITs, RECs, Central Universities, etc., to
recruit fresh graduates for its Force;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether IAF has revised HRD norms
for this purpose; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Effect of globalisation on
carpet trade
*236. PROF. SAIF-UD-DIN SOZ: Will
the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether globalisation has hit Indian
carpet trade; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Arrest of women during
nighthours
*237. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
DR. AKHILESH DAS:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether existing rule/law permits
arrest of women during night hours by
policemen without presence of women
police;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether a recent judgement of the
Supreme Court has allowed the arrest of
women during night hours without presence
of women police;
(d)  whether any representation has been
submitted against the above order of the
Supreme Court; and
(e)  if so, whether competent authority
propose to initiate various measures to
ensure that women are not arrested during
night hours without presence of women
police?
Death penalty for rapists
*238. SHRI  S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether a proposal to provide death
as one of the penalties for the offence of
rape, is still under consideration of the
Government; and
(b) if so, the status of the proposal?

72
WIN2/NSESSION\3901RS 72
Scheme for revival of national
Textile Corporation Mills
†*239. SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a scheme
worth Rs. 3,383 crores has been worked
out for the revival of certain mills of the
National Textile Corporation;
(b)  if so, when the scheme was
accorded final approval; whether it is also a
fact that the said amount was planned to be
mobilised by the sale of surplus plots of land
under the textile mills; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) if so, the amount mobilised under the
scheme and whether it is also a fact that
Government have already spent Rs. 750
crore in connection with this scheme?
Singapore-India defence cooperation
*240. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Singapore and India have
signed a defence cooperation agreement;
(b)  if so, the details thereof;
(c)  whether the Navies of the two
countries have held joint exercises; and
(d)  if so, the details thereof?

Mining by State Government
companies/PSUs
1543. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
DR. A.R. KIDWAI:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government's order
authorizing State Government companies
or undertakings to do regular coal or lignite
mining has been welcomed by States;
(b) whether many States have shown
interest to take up coal mining as business
through joint ventures with private
investors;
(c) whether Government has taken
away all purchasing powers that were
delegated to Coal India Limited and
marketing rights enjoyed by CIL for non-
core sector consumers;
(d) whether as most State
Governments do not have expertise or
money to undertake coal-mining activities,
they are looking for private partners; and
(e) if so, to what extent they have been
successful?
Emission of gas from coal mines
†1544. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have conducted
any study in respect of human use of the
gas emitting out of the coal mines;
(b) if so, the broad details thereof;
(c) the quantity of gas estimated to be
emitted out of the coal mines of the country
per annum; and
(d) in what form it can be used by
transforming for human consumption?
Revival of Eastern Coalfields Ltd.
1545. SHRI DIPANKAR MUKHER-
JEE: Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) the present revival status of Eastern
Coalfields Ltd. (ECL);
(b) whether there is any time-bound
action plan to bring ECL out of BIFR; and
(c) if no, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

338
WIN2/NSESSION\3902RS 338
Demand and Production of Coal
1546. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether the damand of coal in the
country is fully met by the domestic
production;
(b) the details regarding the mine-wise
production and the country's annual demand
of coal; and
(c) the details of import of coal for the
last three years?
Setting up  coal based power plant
in M.P. by N.L.C.
1547. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the Government of Madhya Pradesh has
asked Neyveli Lignite Corporation to
examine putting up a 1000 MW coal based
power plant in Madhya Pradesh;
(b) if so, the steps being taken in this
regard; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Opening up coal mining to the
private sector
1548. SHRI RUMANDLA RAAMA-
CHANDRAYYA: Will the Minister of
COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to open
up coal mining to the private sector;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) its impact thereof on defence,
railways etc.?
Non-recovery of electricity
charges from the employees
of South Eastern
Coalfields Ltd.
1549. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether South Eastern Coalfields
Ltd. provided residential quarters to its
employees who were required to pay
electricity charges beyond the consumption
of 30 units per month as per the National
Coal Wage Agreements;
(b) if so, whether no charges towards
the consumption of electricity were
recovered from the employees between
April, 1999 to March, 2002 and if so, the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether the amount involved as  a
result of non-recovery  of electricity charges
has been recovered; and
(d) if not, the reasons and  the persons
responsible  therefor?
Accident in Singareni Collieries
Mines
1550. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to refer to
the reply to Starred Question 48 given in
the Rajya Sabha on the 23rd July, 2003 and
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that another
serious accident occurred in a mine of the
Singareni Collieries on the night between
the 16th and 17th October, 2003;
(b) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the number of mine workers who died/
injured in the accident; and
(c) whether inquiry into the mishap has
been conducted; if so, the outcome thereof
and action taken thereon?

339
WIN2/NSESSION\3902RS 339
Discovery of coalfields by G.S.I
1551. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) the State-wise names of places where
the Geological Survey of India has found
new coalfields during the last decade;
(b) the quantities of coal in each of the
new found places; and
(c) how far this coal will meet the
requirements of thermal power stations and
steel industry sector?
Infiltration of terrorists
1552. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken any
action on the reports of the Indian Army
to the effect that there are no improvement
in the situation of infiltration of terrorists
and shelling in the entire Kargil area in the
State of Jammu and Kashmir;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that the ISI
of Pakistan has innovated its strategy to
infiltrate into the areas of Leh and Ladakh
in Jammu and Kashmir; and
(c) Government's reaction thereto?
Frieswal culled calves of military
farms
1553. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
SHRI LALITBHAI MEHTA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a decision has been taken to
provide frieswal culled calves of military
farms to Gaushalas through NGO's;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that calves
of the age of 14 days and below are given to
Gaushalas; and
(c) whether the rearing period of surplus
calves of military farms of 14 days age,
would be increased to at least 30 days as
the calves need mother's milk till they reach
the age of 90 days?
Infiltrations  during Pakistani
shelling
1554. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Pakistani
Army starts shelling across the LoC either
to give cover fire to infiltrators across the
LoC or to divert the attention of Indian
Army and BSF posted across the LoC so
that infiltrators can get in;
(b) if so, whether the same has been
happening for a number of years now;
(c) if so, what steps  do the Army and
BSF normally take during such course of
action; and
(d) whether according to Government
statistics of the Army and BSF, infiltrations
across the LoC are the maximum during
Pakistani shelling?
Decreasing profitability of Mishra
Dhatu Nigam Ltd., Hyderabad
1555. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the profitability of Mishra
Dhatu Nigam Ltd., Hyderabad in
consistently decreasing for the last few
years;
(b) if so, the details thereof for the last
four years, year-wise;
(c) the reasons therefor; and

340
WIN2/NSESSION\3902RS 340
(d) the steps taken  by Government to
improve the situation?
Reduction in avian menace
1556. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Air Force has successfully reduced the
avian menace; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Flag meetings between coast guard
and marine security agency of
Pakistan
1557. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Coast Guard has put
forward any new proposals for periodical
flag meetings between Cost Guard and the
Marine Security Agency of Pakistan;
(b) if yes, the details of the proposal; and
(c) how these new proposals help the
Indian fishermen who are languishing in
Pakistan jails and the fishermen who stray,
unintentionally, in the Pakistani waters?
Attaining self-sufficiency in
Missile Defence System
1558. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether India is still importing surface
to air missiles from Russia;
(b) if so, whether India is still not self-
sufficient in indigenous air attack missile
defence systems; and
(c) the target for making India self-
sufficient in this regard?
Induction of mid-air refuelling
system by Indian Air Force
1559. SHRI RUMANDLA
RAAMACHANDRAYYA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Air Force have
inducted mid air refuelling and weapon
platforms in space; and
(b) if so, the futuristic weapons systems
India propose to add as is being done by
the advanced countries?
Amendment in Building
Construction Rules of Defence
Cantonments
1560. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a)  the details of recent amendments
made in Building Construction Rules in
Defence Cantonments regarding increase
of  FSI to accord permission for
construction of more floors;
(b) whether in the light of amendment
towards increase of FSI, Government will
pave a rule and initiate the process of
regularising thousands of Buildings with
unauthorised floors in Secunderabad
Cantonment to secure property taxes of all
such unauthorised floors to Secunderabad
Cantonment, Board, which the Board is
deprived of at present;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the details of various amendments
as made in Defence Cantonment Rules,
recently?

341

Strike power of IAF
1561. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian Air
Force propose to double its strike power;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when the proposal is likely to be
implemented?
Files regarding financial
irregularities
1562. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
more than 90 documents and files pertaining
to financial irregularities involving several
crores of rupees against Brig. V.P. Singh,
which the CBI is probing, were destroyed
by Senior Military Officer by getting the
office opened on an public holiday on the
pretext of working on the accounts;
(b) whether it is also a fact that this
major Security breach took place in the
Military Farms Headquarter at Army
Headquarter on the 28th and 29th June,
2003, and
(c) if so, what are the details thereof
and what action Government have taken
against the officials found involved in this
regard?
Refurbishing of life expired  missiles
1563. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has a
massive stockpile of missiles accumulated
over the last 25 years which are now
becoming life expired;
(b) whether Bharat Dynamics Ltd.,
India's public sector missile manufacturing
unit based at Hyderabad will be the nodel
agency to refurbish these missiles and
upgrade them at 20 per cent of the cost of
new ones; and
(c) if so, what is the reliability of this
refurbishing and upgrading plan to ensure
that these missiles will continue to be
efficient and effective operationally?
Infiltration from Bangladesh
1564. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to refer
to the Statement given at Chandigarh on
27.9.2003 confirming infiltration from
Bangladesh and state:
(a) whether Government have taken up
the matter of infiltration with Bangladesh
authorities to take effective measures to
stop infiltration;
(b) whether Government have
attributed this infiltration into India a total
failure of paramilitary forces who indulge
in malpractices which encourage them in
their clandestine business without
interruptions; and
(c) the Government's reaction thereto?
MIG repairs
1565. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is  a fact that poor quality
of repairs and upgrades carried out by non-
Russian Companies are the major causes
for MIG crashes in the country;
(b) the details of companies from where
parts for MIG aircraft are procured;
(c) the details of companies which have
carried out the repairs for MIG during the
last five years; and
(d) the steps that the Ministry is taking
to reduce the MIG crashes?

342

WIN2/NSESSION\3901RS 342
Recruitment of Kashmiri Pandit
Youth
1566. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
conduct a special drive for recruitment of
Kashmiri Pandit Youth in order to eradicate
unemployment within this minority
community; and
(b) when this drive is likely to
commence and the number of Youth to be
recruited in the Armed Forces?
Indo-China joint military exercise
1567. SHRI RUMANDLA
RAAMACHANDRAYYA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and China propose to
hold joint military exercises as is being done
with the United States; and
(b) by when a final decision is likely to
be taken in this regard?
Purchase of laser guidance kits/
penetration bombs
1568. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether C&AG in his Report No. 7
of 2003 observed that the Ministry made
purchases of laser guidance kits to
penetration bombs at a higher price than
the settled one;
(b) if so, the details and reasons therefor;
(c) the additional expenditure incurred
as a result thereof;
(d) whether due to mismatch between
the kits and the bombs, the shelf life of the
kits was reduced; and
(e) if so, the reasons for going on
emergency purchases and action taken on
the report?
Utilising  private  airlines  for
ferrying troops and materials
1569. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Jet Airlines
has been chartered by the Army to ferry
troops and materials from sensitive locations
in Ladakh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to
utilise the services of private airlines for
similar situation in difficult terrains; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Enhancing the fire  power of Infantry
Units
1570. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of steps taken specially in
enhancing the fire-power , reconnaissance
and surveillance capabilities of all Infantry
Units in India;
(b) whether our Army Infantry Units
specially on our Borders are equipped with
human and arms detecting sensors,
battlefield surveillance radars, hand held
thermals, various types of rocket launchers
and automatic grenade launchers etc.;
(c) if so, details of those items which are
imported from foreign countries and names
of such foreign countries;
(d) if so, whether Government has made
any effort to manufacture those items in our
country; and
(e) if  not, the reasons therefor?

343
WIN2/NSESSION\3902RS 343
Acquisition of F-16 Falcons
1571. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that IAF pilots
have recently been sent to US to fly F-16
Falcons;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that Pakistan
has acquired the Falcon aircraft; and
(c) if so, what efforts are being made by
India to acquire the same or similar aircraft
for India?
Performance of Israeli Barak defence
system
1572. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
